correctness.rationale: Adjoint integration by parts gives J=p(0)x0+int sigma u; minimization on each grid cell exactly yields int|sigma|-|int sigma|, zero except cells containing roots. Taylor C² remainder and 2-Lipschitz control of this local functional yield uniform h³ error for finite isolated roots. Fourier expansion g=1/12+sum(-1)^k cos(2pi k r)/(pi² k²) gives mean sum slopes/12 and m-dependent variance (2pi⁴)^(-1) sum k^-4 |sum slopes exp(2pi i k m tau)|²+O(h). Equal slopes at roots 1/4,3/4 give coefficients 1/180 for even m, 1/2880 for odd m. Independent exact rational phase moments checked. No general asymptotic fixed constant is improperly asserted.

evidence: Bourdin-Trelat convergence and Scarinci-Veliov higher-order Volterra-Fliess scheme apply to broader or different problems, but their rates do not entail the phase-resolved fixed-grid Fourier covariance.
